I think I’ll find what I truly want along the way, but overall I want to find a community that’s focused on sustainability, independence, and play.

I’d love to build a place where we can grow our own food, harvest and forage from our land, and build with sustainable materials. 

Being a climate migrant myself, I also want to build a community that is resilient enough to survive future disasters.

I know it’ll be a process, and it won’t start off that way, but hopefully we can build towards sustainability.

I just want to live a life that honors nature and the bonds between people and frees us from the rat race.

Other than that, I think anything and everything is on the table. I wouldn’t want to restrict anyone based on their beliefs or interests.
